1. Agreement

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of VertexStealth, including the desktop application, its browser-profile tools and the account service behind it (together, the "Service"). By creating an account, installing, or using the Service you agree to these Terms, the End User License Agreement ("EULA") and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

You must be at least 18 years old (or the age of majority where you live) and legally able to enter a binding contract. If you use the Service for an organisation, you confirm you are authorised to bind it, and "you" includes that organisation.

2. What the Service is

VertexStealth lets you create and launch separate browser profiles, each with its own configuration (for example fingerprint values, language, time zone, screen size, proxy and stored browser data), so that different browsing identities stay separate from one another. It is a privacy and multi-account management tool. It runs on your own computer. We do not browse on your behalf and we do not see the websites you visit or the data stored in your browser profiles.

3. Your account

  • Give us accurate information and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for all activity under your account.
  • One account per person and one account per device. To enforce the free trial and to enforce bans, the first account that signs in on a device is bound to that device using a hashed device identifier (see the Privacy Policy). Creating additional accounts to obtain another trial, or to avoid a suspension or ban, is not permitted.
  • Tell us promptly at support@vertexstealth.top if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.
  • We may refuse registration or remove accounts that are fraudulent, duplicate or in breach of these Terms.

4. Plans, free trial and fees

Free trial. Each account (and each device) is eligible for one free trial of 3 days, with up to 3 browser profiles at a time. The trial ends automatically, cannot be restarted or extended, and may be withdrawn if we detect abuse. A trial account can only be used on the device it was first used on.

After the trial. When the trial ends you need a paid plan to keep using your browser profiles. Your profiles are not deleted: they are locked and become usable again as soon as a paid plan is active. We may adjust plan limits and features from time to time; where a change materially reduces what you have paid for, we will give notice under section 11.

Paid plans. Paid plans remove the free-plan limits and are offered on these terms:

Plan Price Billing period
Monthly US$10.00 1 month
Annual US$89.00 12 months

Prices are in US dollars and exclude any applicable taxes (such as VAT or sales tax), which are added at checkout where required.

Payment methods. We accept payment by credit or debit card, by PayPal, and by cryptocurrency through Binance Pay. Payments are processed by independent third-party payment providers; we do not receive or store your full card number. You authorise us and our payment providers to charge the payment method you select.

Renewal. Card and PayPal subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period at the then-current price until you cancel. Cryptocurrency payments are one-off payments for a single billing period and do not renew automatically; we will remind you before your access expires so you can pay again. Cryptocurrency payments are priced in US dollars and converted at the rate shown at checkout; network and exchange fees are your responsibility, and you must send the exact amount requested.

Cancellation. You may cancel a subscription at any time from your payment provider's subscription settings or by emailing support@vertexstealth.top. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; you keep paid access until then and are not charged again.

Price changes. We may change prices for future billing periods by giving at least 30 days' notice. The new price applies from your next renewal, and you may cancel before then.

Refunds. If you are dissatisfied with your first purchase of a paid plan, you may request a full refund within 7 days of that purchase by emailing support@vertexstealth.top, provided the Service has not been used in breach of these Terms. After that, fees are non-refundable, including for partly used billing periods and for accounts suspended or terminated for breach. Refunds are returned to the original payment method; for cryptocurrency, a refund is made in the same cryptocurrency or its US-dollar equivalent at the time of the refund, less network fees. Nothing in this section limits any right to a refund that the law gives you and that cannot be waived.

Failed payments. If a payment fails or is reversed, we may suspend paid features until the amount is settled.
